title: UniverseAgentRanking
description: The Universe Selector agent's raw structured response. Prose is not a valid response - every field here is validated before anything downstream sees it, and a ranking that fails validation is rejected rather than repaired. The agent may only reorder and select from the candidates it was given; it can never admit an asset the deterministic filter excluded.

run_id.description: Echoed from the input, so a response can be matched to the request that produced it.

notes.description: Free text, retained for audit only. Never parsed, and never able to change an outcome.

symbol.description: Must be one of the supplied candidates. An unrecognised symbol invalidates the whole ranking.

rank.description: Required for SELECTED, forbidden for NOT_SELECTED. Ranks must be unique and contiguous from 1.

reasons.description: Codes from a closed vocabulary. Each one is checked against the candidate's own evidence: a claim the supplied data contradicts invalidates the ranking.

rationale.description: One sentence, for a human reader. Advisory: the machine-readable reasons are authoritative.

reason_code.description: No directional, option-level, or capital-allocation code exists here by design. The universe selector is not a trader, a predictor, an option strategist or a risk engine.
